create.excerpt: Nollamara Tennis Club runs social pickleball three times a week on its outdoor courts. Visitors pay a $10 fee, paddles are supplied, and newcomers get a short introduction before playing with rotating partners.
create.flags: SCHEDULE CONFLICT: Pickleball WA lists Monday 6:30-8:30pm, Thursday 4:30-6:30pm and 6:45-8:45pm, and Sunday 5-7pm; the club's own page (used here) lists Tuesday/Thursday 6:30-8:30pm and Sunday 3-5pm. create.title: Baldivis Indoor Sports Complex
create.excerpt: The City of Rockingham runs pay-on-arrival pickleball sessions on the indoor courts at Baldivis Indoor Sports Complex. There are two kinds: pickleball games on Wednesday mornings and Sunday evenings, and cheaper casual sessions on Tuesday and Friday mornings.
create.flags: Pickleball WA lists Wednesday mornings, Friday mornings and Sunday afternoons; the council page (used here) gives Wednesday and Sunday games plus Tuesday/Friday casual sessions. The published weekend hours (closing 4:30pm) conflict with the Sunday 4:30-6:30pm session; ask the centre. The page does not say whether paddles can be borrowed or whether sessions suit beginners. It is at the southern edge of the metro area (City of Rockingham). The council's lifestyle timetable publication returned no results. | Pinned Google place "Baldivis Indoor Sports Complex" has no photos; "Baldivis Sports Complex" (same address, 10 photos, id ChIJlVY9tJeIMioRMBSGpGNWQzg) may be the same facility -- check before switching.
